style: Resolute, defensively solid South American side under Gustavo Alfaro, built around a strong centre-back core, physicality and organisation, with directness and threat on transitions through experienced attackers.
recent_form: Returned to the World Cup for the first time since 2010 after a steadying CONMEBOL qualifying run under Alfaro. Drawn in Group D against co-hosts USA, Australia and Turkiye.

key_players.name: Gustavo Gomez
key_players.note: Palmeiras centre-back and squad captain; aerially dominant leader who anchors a disciplined defence.

key_players.name: Miguel Almiron
key_players.note: Atlanta United winger with 75 caps; squad's leading scorer, 10 goal involvements in MLS last season after returning from Newcastle.

key_players.name: Antonio Sanabria
key_players.note: Fulcrum of the attack; scored four goals in qualifying despite limited starts.

key_players.name: Julio Enciso
key_players.note: Brighton-developed forward providing pace and unpredictability in the final third.

key_players.name: Diego Gomez
key_players.note: Brighton midfielder adding energy, drive and goal threat from deep.

key_players.name: Omar Alderete
key_players.note: Premier League-linked defender who partners Gustavo Gomez in central defence.

historical_news: First World Cup appearance since South Africa 2010 for La Albirroja.
Squad assembled by Gustavo Alfaro with a Brazil-heavy and MLS contingent.
Open their tournament in Group D against co-hosts USA, Australia and Turkiye.

media_sentiment.label: neutral
media_sentiment.summary: Coverage praises Alfaro's defensive rebuild and the return to the finals while questioning a lack of cutting edge up front in a competitive group.
